title: Command Code mods registry
description: The curated layer behind commandcode.ai/mods. Packages published to npm with the `cmd-mod` keyword are listed automatically; this file adds git-only mods, richer metadata over npm entries (matched by `npm`), and the `hidden` list for moderation. The resolved list is served at https://commandcode.ai/mods.json.

hidden.description: Mod names (or npm package names) to keep off the hub — spam, malware, impersonation.

name.description: Display name, and the name `cmd mods list` prints.

source.description: What `cmd mods add <source>` takes: an npm name (`cmd-mod-hi`, `@team/mod`), or GitHub shorthand (`owner/repo`).

repo.description: Public git repository URL. GitHub repos get a live star count.

npm.description: npm package name when published to npm. Drives the monthly download count.

kinds.description: What the mod registers on the ModApi.

official.description: Maintained by the Command Code team.

featured.description: Pinned to the top of the hub. Maintainer-only.

addedAt.description: ISO date the mod was listed.
